assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: README style reference; intended use: A six-style comparison of this individual source photograph for the Art Skill README
Primary request: A lush sloping hillside garden with a thick foreground tree trunk on the left, tall slender conifers across the center-right, dense layered foliage, distant bluish hills, a small blue roof lower-center, external stairs at far left and a curving path on the right beneath a bright cloudy sky.
Style/medium: raster illustration with intentional pixel blocks and glyph-like stippling
Color palette: #EFEBDD, #242722, #67826E, #B99054
Materials/textures: crisp block edges and printed dot texture
Composition/framing: a clear silhouette, restrained detail, deliberate negative space; Keep landscape orientation and the original broad framing; one image, no frame or panels
Lighting/mood: flat graphic light with limited tonal steps
Requested output target: 1536x1024, opaque background, png; use only supported tool controls
Avoid: real people; copyrighted characters; logos and brand marks; copied artworks; unrequested lettering
Constraints: Keep the original layered garden viewpoint, left tree trunk, tall conifer rhythm, slope, distant hills and curving path. Simplify minor details only to suit the medium. Do not add a sea, island bay, rainbow or sunset.; No added people, brands, characters, captions or signatures; Use only this source photograph as the composition reference; never mix motifs from the other photos
